judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` via `accumulateUsage`, adds thorough unit and acceptance tests covering multi-round turns and missing round usage, and preserves compatibility via an `AggregatedUsage` sub-interface alongside renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`. However, it completely missed updating `CHANGELOG.md`, which was an explicit acceptance criterion in the issue (and in its own unchecked `.lore/dod.md` item). It also left the temporary `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository and kept the new `afterModelResponse` bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of moving it to the in-scope section. Aside from introducing the harmless `AggregatedUsage` type alias and placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, the core logic and signature changes closely match the reference.
